## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Yì yuàn shū* in 10 fascicles is the major Northern-Sòng commentary on [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *[Wǔ jiào zhāng 五教章](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0074)* (T1866). Composed by [道亭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E4%BA%AD) Dàotíng (active late 11th c.) of the Zháxī Pǔjìngsì 霅溪普靜寺 in Wúxīng 吳興 / Húzhōu 湖州, the work is the earliest extant systematic commentary on Fǎzàng's foundational doxographical treatise.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to the period 1080 – 1090 CE, the bracket up to the dated postface. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The *Yì yuàn shū* is the foundational document of the Sòng commentary tradition on the *Wǔ jiào zhāng*; it inaugurated a tradition of Huáyán-school commentarial scholarship that would continue through [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì's *[Fén xīn 焚薪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0076)* (X996), *[Fù gǔ jì 復古記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0078)* (X998), and [希迪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%8C%E8%BF%AA) Xīdí's *[Jí chéng jì 集成記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0079)* (X999) and *[Píng fù gǔ jì 評復古記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0080)* (X1000) — the most extensive Sòng commentary tradition on a single Huáyán-school text.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* 續藏經 (X995) collection.
